4477-8043-8350.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4477-8043-8350.description:
Cast Face Yourself for free due to Vision, targeting yourself and creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste and the noted exile clause.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Face Yourself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-2841-8105-8337.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Escape Tunnel.
1479-2841-8105-8337.description:
Fetch a land using Escape Tunnel.
When the fetched land enters, M'Ress and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and M'Ress trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, M'Ress triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

250-779-1479-5414-8338.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5414-8338.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-5414-8338.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

1170-2397-3389-5954-8345.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Warp Speed.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

147-4452-8200.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Grub's Command
147-4452-8200.description:
Cast Grub's Command by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Grub's Command, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Grub's Command, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
147-4452-8200.notes: When choosing modes, the other mode you choose will net additional results.

2034-6982--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When that creature enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Remove a +1/+1 and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

5551-5552-8095.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
5551-5552-8095.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Kaslem that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Kaslem that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat from step 4.

772-3175-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
772-3175-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1874-1981-2415-2511.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1874-1981-2415-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2438-6752.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2438-6752.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4478-7794.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4478-7794.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Koma, triggering Breath of Fury and Koma.
Resolve the Koma trigger, creating four creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

339-677-2438-5434.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

254-6798--5.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 2

1409-2933-4460-5798.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Drowner of Hope.
1409-2933-4460-5798.description:
Activate Drowner of Hope by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Drowner of Hope trigger, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Drowner of Hope.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

4905-5220-6900-7192.description:
Cast Fanatical Firebrand by paying its mana cost.
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Grave Venerations trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4871-6633-7072.description:
Activate Joo Dee by paying {B} and tapping it, causing you to surveil 1 and then create a token copy of Joo Dee and sacrifice the tapped Joo Dee.
When the tapped Joo Dee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat using the Joo Dee token.

225-280-5702-6850.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
225-280-5702-6850.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-280-5702-6850.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm. When it enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant, Golgari Rot Farm and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Golgari Rot Farm.
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Icetill Explorer.
Because of the additional Icetill Explorer token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

222-527-6798-6968.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-6798-6968.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-1283-6774.easyPrerequisites: Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-1283-6774.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

2438-4484-4871-4924-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2438-4484-4871-4924-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2438-4484-4871-4924-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

628-2034-6672.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrifiicing Bloodied Ghost.
When Bloodied Ghost dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it. When it enters, Bloodied Ghost will put a -1/-1 counter on itself, removing the +1/+1 counter.
Repeat.

1548-6473.easyPrerequisites: Port Razer exiled by Mardu Siegebreaker.
1548-6473.notablePrerequisites:
Port Razer cannot be blocked by an opponent.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
1548-6473.description:
Declare Mardu Siegebreaker as an attacker, triggering its second ability, creating a token copy of Port Razer that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage with the Port Razer token, triggering its ability, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2525-3358-4885.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Body Double by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1809-1987-4125-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1809-1987-4125-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Shipwreck Dowser and Returned Pastcaller.
When Shipwreck Dowser and Returned Pastcaller enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1809-1987-4125-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

1170-2146-3363-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking The One Ring.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.

1636-2527-2921-3143.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate that has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
1636-2527-2921-3143.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from the additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the additional Human, Fungus and/or Pirate.
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1308-1744-3487-5770.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating ten token copies of Aetherstorm Roc.
When the Aetherstorm Roc tokens enter the battlefield, each Aetherstorm Roc you control triggers ten times, causing you to get 110 {E}.
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating a 6/6 Beast artifact creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, each Aetherstorm Roc you control triggers, causing you to get eleven {E}.
Repeat from step 3.

56-4050-5695.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hogaak, adding one mana of any color.
When Hogaak dies, Infested Thrinax triggers, creating eight 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by tapping seven Saprolings.
Repeat from step 3.

2011-4871-5549.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Treasures.
2011-4871-5549.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Vihaan triggers, causing all Treasures you control to become 3/3 Construct Assassins in addition to their other types.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
When the Treasures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers five times, creating five Treasure tokens.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

38-4871-5433.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure.
38-4871-5433.description:
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Krenko triggers, causing you to pay {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token with haste.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing the Goblin token, adding {R}.
When the Goblin dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4885-5359.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4885-5359.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Threefold Thunderhulk as attackers.
Threefold Thunderhulk triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3718-4212.notablePrerequisites: You control an indestructible noncreature permanent.
3718-4212.description:
Cast Chain of Acid by paying {3}{G}, targeting an indestructible noncreature permanent you control.
Silverquill Apprentice triggers, giving a creature you control +1/+0 until end of turn.
Resolve Chain of Acid, destroying nothing and causing you to copy Chain of Acid, targeting an indestructible noncreature permanent you control.
Repeat from step 2.

317-997-1475.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional modified creature with power one or greater.
317-997-1475.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another modified creature with power one or greater.
When the creature dies, Mazirek and One with the Kami triggers.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Resolve the Mazirek trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

719-3496-4071-4625.description:
Cast Dread Slaver by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Dread Slaver enters the battlefield, Be'lakor's second ability triggers, causing Dread Slaver to deal damage equal to its power to itself.
Dread Slaver dies as a state-based action due to its deathtouch.
Dread Slaver triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1650-2290-4384.notablePrerequisites:
Arachnoform attached to Spike Feeder.
Spike Feeder has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1650-2290-4384.description:
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to gain two life.
Treebeard triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Spike Feeder.
Repeat.
Once Spike Feeder has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may target any other Halfling or Treefolk with Treebeard's ability.

927-3243.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Jon Irenicus triggers, giving control of Tethered Griffin to an opponent who controls no enchantments.
When Tethered Griffin's controller controls no enchantments, Tethered Griffin triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Tethered Griffin cannot be sacrificed due to its ability.
Tethered Griffin triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

215-3003-4050-5031.notablePrerequisites: Skitterbeam Batallion in hand.You control at least nine artifacts.
215-3003-4050-5031.description:
Cast Skitterbeam Batallion by paying {0}.
Skitterbeam Batallion enters the battlefield, creating two token copies of it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the two Skitterbeam Batallion tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Skitterbeam Batallion from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2488-2772.description:
Cast Outmuscle by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, causing Apex Alitsaur to gain indestructible until end of turn, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and then causing it to fight an opponent's creature with power one or greater.
Apex Altisaur is dealt damage by the creature, triggering its enrage ability, causing it to fight an opponent's creature with power one or greater.
Repeat step 2.

1634-1927-3858-4690.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four basic lands.
1634-1927-3858-4690.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, cast Phylath by paying {4}{R}{G}.
Phylath enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Devilish Valet.
Resolve the Phylath trigger, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token for each basic land you control.
Each Plant token enters the battlefield, triggering Devilish Valet that many times.
Resolve a Devilish Valet trigger, doubling its power until end of turn.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining Devilish Valet trigger.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life and win the game.

803-2257-4508.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
803-2257-4508.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Reckless Fireweaver triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Reckless Fireweaver is a Pirate due to Arcane Adaptation, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Reckless Fireweaver triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Reckless Fireweaver trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

250-779-5014.description:
Activate Putrid Imp by discarding Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's third ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Putrid Imp ability, giving it flying until end of turn.
Repeat.
